name: anger-management
description: Vent at your agent session and capture the moment as a friction paper-cut. Each venting command (/fuck, /shit, /crap, /wtf, /bullshit, /damn) appends one cheap line to a deterministic log instead of demanding a constructive fix right now; /anger-management reads the log back, surfaces recurring patterns, and hands them to self-improvement. The vocabulary is deliberately gender-neutral and non-discriminatory.
